newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Former Sydney Olympic chief Iliffe dies.
newsitem.headline: Former Sydney Olympic chief Iliffe dies.

text.p: John Iliffe, a leading Australian businessman who briefly led Sydney's preparations for the 2000 Olympic Games, has died at the age of 60.
Iliffe's death on Saturday was announced by retailer Woolworths Ltd, of which he was chairman. He was also chairman of insurance group GIO Australia Holdings Ltd.
Iliffe was appointed president of the Sydney Organising Committee for the Olympic Games (SOCOG) in March 1996 but only held the post for six months.

He was replaced in September by local politician Michael Knight, the New South Wales state Olympics minister, after the International Olympic Committee decided that the Sydney Games needed unambiguous political support.
Iliffe, who underwent surgery earlier this month, is believed to have been suffering from cancer.
